nodes.name: candygoogy.dev
nodes.blurb: I keep computers running, and build the tools I wish existed.
nodes.summary: I’m an IT technician by day. On my own time I build software and websites, and Fettle is the one I’m proudest of.

nodes.name: Fettle
nodes.blurb: Windows check-up, printed as a readable receipt
nodes.summary: A free, open-source check-up for Windows PCs. It reads what Windows already knows and prints it as a receipt: a plain-words verdict on every line, the next steps at the top, and the numbers underneath for anyone who wants them.

nodes.name: featherplay
nodes.blurb: Native Windows player for YouTube Music, unofficial
nodes.summary: A free, open-source Windows player for YouTube Music. It plays your library, playlists and radio in one native program, with no browser behind the window and no video.

nodes.name: tellall
nodes.blurb: What an image or a text gives away, and a clean copy
nodes.summary: A free, open-source privacy check for images and copied text. It tells you in plain sentences what they give away and makes a clean copy, on your device.
nodes.runsOn: A web browser, or Node.js 20.19 or later

nodes.name: Install diff
nodes.blurb: What an installer did to your PC, in plain words
nodes.summary: A free, open-source command-line tool for Windows. It tells you, in plain words, what an app’s installer did to your PC and what it left behind after you uninstalled it. It only reads.

nodes.name: phantomlink-sensors
nodes.blurb: Sapphire PhantomLink power connector temperatures in HWiNFO
nodes.summary: A small background tool for the Sapphire NITRO+ RX 9070 XT PhantomLink. The card measures the temperature at its 12V-2x6 and GC-HPWR power connectors, but only Sapphire’s TriXX shows it. This tool reads the same sensors and adds them to HWiNFO, to graph, log and alert on. It never writes to the card.

nodes.name: Notary
nodes.blurb: Claude Code mods that check Claude’s work
nodes.summary: Two small mods for Claude Code. Changes keeps a turn-by-turn timeline of what Claude edited, with each file’s diff and a Revert that refuses rather than guesses. Receipts checks Claude’s “all tests pass” against the tests it actually ran.

nodes.name: candygoogy-bot
nodes.blurb: Telegram bot that wakes and shuts down my PCs
nodes.summary: A Telegram bot that runs on an always-on home server and wakes, sleeps and shuts down the PCs on the same network. Every power action asks first, and the bot reports what actually happened, like “Booted in 45s.” It also keeps an eye on the server itself: disks, services, containers and backups.

nodes.name: Dolci Eoliani
nodes.blurb: Pastry shop site with WhatsApp ordering
nodes.summary: An online shop window for an artisan pastry shop. Customers browse the pastries, put an order together and send it on WhatsApp. The site is in Italian, and every page is prerendered so search engines can read it.

nodes.name: Siel Eolie
nodes.blurb: Bilingual company site, built without a framework
nodes.summary: The bilingual site of the electrical firm I work for: its services, certifications and past work. No framework, just HTML, CSS and a little JavaScript, built to load fast.

nodes.name: Eolietech
nodes.blurb: Free file tools that run in your browser
nodes.summary: Free tools for images, PDFs and audio that run in your browser, so your files never leave your device. The page’s security policy stops it sending them anywhere, and the site shows how to check that yourself. No ads, no accounts.

nodes.name: Experiments
nodes.summary: Small tools that run in your browser.

nodes.summary: The network I run at home, and the machines I work on.

nodes.name: Colophon
nodes.summary: How this site is made, for anyone who wonders.
